name: Ortell's Hideout
summary: Hermit Ortell keeps to a cave against the mountains in southeastern Silithus. Few choose to live alone in this barren wasteland.

sections.title: A Hermit's Shelter
sections.body: In southeastern Silithus, a cave among the cliffs shelters Hermit Ortell. Sandstorms sweep the wastes, and silithid swarms prowl beyond his door. He lives alone, far from civilization and the fortified garrisons of the Cenarion Hold. Travelers brave the dangerous route to this remote corner to seek his peculiar knowledge of the desert and its hazards.

faq.answer: Ortell's Hideout lies in the mountain rock along Silithus's southeastern edge. It stands against the border cliffs, far from the central desert roads.
Hermit Ortell lives alone in a small cave, apart from the Cenarion Circle expedition and the factions of the world. He chooses to dwell amid Silithus's dangers.

faq.q: Is Ortell's Hideout safe from the silithid?
aliases: are there bugs in the cave
faq.answer: The cave itself is free of silithid, but the surrounding zone is hostile, with silithid and Twilight's Hammer cultists. Reaching the hideout means crossing perilous terrain.
